parts.label: (a)
parts.text: State two conditions necessary for a mass to be undergoing simple harmonic motion.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.part_stem:
A trolley of mass $950\text{ g}$ is held on a horizontal surface by means of two springs attached to fixed points P and Q, as shown in Fig. 4.1.

{{figure:figure_4_1}}

Fig. 4.1

The springs, each having a spring constant $k$ of $230\text{ N m}^{-1}$, are always extended.

The trolley is displaced along the line of the springs and then released.
The variation with time $t$ of the displacement $x$ of the trolley is shown in Fig. 4.2.

{{figure:figure_4_2}}

Fig. 4.2
parts.text:
1. State and explain whether the oscillations of the trolley are heavily damped, critically damped or lightly damped.

2. Suggest the cause of the damping.

parts.label: (b)(ii)1
parts.part_stem:
The acceleration $a$ of the trolley of mass $m$ may be assumed to be given by the expression

$$a = -\left(\frac{2k}{m}\right)x.$$
parts.text: Calculate the angular frequency $\omega$ of the oscillations of the trolley.

parts.label: (b)(ii)2
parts.text: Determine the time $t_{1}$ shown on Fig. 4.2.
